notes: Compares against after-manual-fixes (2026-08-20), the last recorded milestone before the compiler.

renderMs improved at every row count: 655/1108/6245ms -> 682/947/4279ms (1k roughly flat, 10k/100k down ~15-30%) -- the compiler auto-memoizing DataTableContext's Provider value (previously rebuilt every render) cuts unnecessary re-renders of every context consumer.
keyboardNavP50/P95 improved noticeably: 54.5/97, 56.5/135, 55/136 -> 26/40, 27/46, 36/139 -- same context-memoization effect, since every keypress re-renders through DataTableRoot's provider.

editCommitMs is roughly flat to slightly up: 99/93/286ms -> 92/107/218ms -- within noise at 1k/10k, improved at 100k; edit-commit was already the most manually-optimized path from the prior milestone, so compiler auto-memoization had less headroom to add here.

Two functions each in DataTable.tsx and Combobox.tsx (DataTableRoot/DataTableBody/DataTableRowComponent and Combobox/ComboboxPopover) carry a per-function "use no memo" directive -- they create or read methods off a @tanstack/react-virtual instance, whose persistent-but-mutating-internally reference the compiler can't safely reason about (see build-js.mjs comment). Sibling functions in the same files (header/selection cells, the cell editor) are compiled normally.

An interim whole-file-exclusion build (commit 4aa8a22, DataTable.tsx/Combobox.tsx entirely opted out) measured within noise of these per-function numbers -- 854/1013/4683ms render, 82/92/230ms edit, 56/121 - 55.5/128 - 71.5/132 keyboard nav -- but was never written to this file since it was superseded by the per-function refinement before a milestone commit.

Bundle size moved from 54.67 KB gzip (whole-file exclusion) to 57.18 KB (per-function opt-out) -- compiling more functions adds memoization boilerplate (~2.5 KB) even though those functions were already fast; this is the expected, honest direction, not a regression. Both fit under the raised 70 KB budget (was 50 KB; see commit 06659ea) with headroom -- a full-spec design system's actual size is now visible in the number instead of hidden behind an artificially tight limit.

scrollDeltaPx stayed 0 at every row count -- correctness preserved: the virtualizer-staleness bug the whole-file exclusion originally guarded against does not reappear with the per-function directives, confirmed by the same automated assertion plus the full 126-test visual regression suite (including combobox.visual.test.ts's large-list, scrolled-40-rows-in case, the one that originally caught this class of bug).
